instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. vitest packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx fails. (1) 'restores an arrow with smaller arrowheadSize ...' line 85: expected undefined to be 0.5; (2) 'copies and pastes arrowheadSize ...' line 193/218: expected undefined to be 0.5; (3) 'undoes and redoes arrowheadSize changes through history deltas' line 173: expect("arrowheadSize" in h.elements[0]).toBe(false) received true. Cause of (1) and (2): API.createElement in packages/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api.ts does NOT forward arrowheadSize to newArrowElement (its arrow branch passes only ...base, width, height, type, points, elbowed), so `API.createElement({ ..., arrowheadSize: 0.5 })` returns an arrow at default size. That helper is outside the write contract and must not be changed. Fix in this test only: create the arrow with API.createElement WITHOUT arrowheadSize, then build the sized one as a new object, e.g. `const smallArrow = { ...API.createElement(baseOpts), arrowheadSize: ARROWHEAD_SIZES.small };` (and the same for every other sized arrow in the file, including the copy/paste test's arrow before API.setElements). Cause of (3): packages/element/src/delta.ts (off-limits, not to be changed) reverts a change by writing `arrowheadSize: undefined`, so after undo the key is present with value undefined. Fix the assertion only: after undo back to default, assert `expect((h.elements[0] as ExcalidrawArrowElement).arrowheadSize).toBeUndefined()` and remove the `"arrowheadSize" in h.elements[0]` check at that point (keep the `in` checks elsewhere: the initial default arrow, Medium from the panel, and paste from a default-sized arrow). Keep all five tests and their intent.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.
